$format: d-pill machine rule registry v1. The engine is scripts/critique.py; it verifies this file matches its implementation before every run. Severity 'error' fails the gate; 'warn' is a judgment call to read, not ignore. Suppression (--allow, or the CI input of the same name) is a written exception: it belongs in the commit that uses it, not in memory.
$scales: Every scale this registry checks is read from references/tokens.json — the verified export of base.css. When the export changes, the gate changes with it. There is no second set of numbers.
$findings: file:line:col [dpill/rule-id] severity: message. Exit 0 clean, 2 findings, 1 broken invocation. Exit 2 with stderr is the Claude Code hook contract: the agent receives the findings as the reason to react.

rules.summary: margin/padding/gap value is not on the space scale
rules.check: px/rem literals in margin, padding, gap, row-gap, column-gap against the space scale (4 8 12 16 24 32 48 64 96 128 px). var(), clamp(), and calc() with var() pass through.
rules.fix: Use --space-1..--space-10 or the classes that carry them (.stack, .cluster, .rows). A value off the scale is a new token decision — write it down or use the scale.

rules.summary: border-radius is not on the radius scale
rules.check: px/rem literals in any border-radius property against 4px, 6px, 10px, 999px. 50% is a warn pointing at --radius-full.

rules.summary: font-size is not on the type ramp
rules.check: px/rem literals in font-size against the ramp (12 13 15 16 18 24 36 56 px; 16 is the coarse-pointer input exception). var() and clamp() pass through.
rules.fix: --text-xs..--text-3xl. A size between two steps is not a size; it is a hesitation.

rules.summary: z-index is not on the z scale
rules.fix: --z-sticky, --z-dropdown, --z-drawer, --z-dialog, --z-toast. A layer that needs 9999 is not a layer; it is a stack nobody mapped.

rules.summary: transition/animation duration is not on the duration scale
rules.check: ms/s literals in transition, animation, and their -duration forms against 120ms, 180ms, 240ms. 0 and 0.01ms (the reduced-motion disable) pass.
rules.fix: --dur-1, --dur-2, --dur-3. The scale is the discipline; a 300ms hover is a different page.

rules.summary: timing function is not a system curve
rules.check: easing keywords and cubic-bezier() literals against the two system curves. var(--ease-*) and spring() pass.
rules.fix: --ease-out (arrival), --ease-in (exit). A new curve is a written exception with the reason.

rules.check: the literal property list 'all' in a transition declaration.
rules.fix: Name the properties that change (background, color, border-color). 'all' animates layout and teaches the page to jank.

rules.check: px/rem literals in border and border-side properties above 1px.
rules.fix: Edges are 1px hairlines. Weight comes from --line-strong, not thickness.

rules.summary: a literal color where a role should be
rules.check: hex, rgb(), hsl(), oklch() literals in color-bearing declarations. var() passes; color-mix over var() passes.
rules.fix: Roles from base.css. A color outside the roles is a chart palette or a written exception, never a mood.

rules.check: per CSS file: any :hover selector and no :focus/:focus-visible in the same file.
rules.fix: base.css draws the ring globally. If this file's controls ride on that, declare it; if not, the keyboard user sees nothing.

rules.summary: motion is used but prefers-reduced-motion appears in no scanned file
rules.check: any duration found and no prefers-reduced-motion media block anywhere in the scanned set.
rules.fix: base.css ships the reduced-motion block. Use it; do not fork the tokens without carrying it.

rules.summary: sizing literals inside a style attribute
rules.fix: Classes and vars. A style attribute with literals in it is a token system nobody uses.

rules.check: every tag carries an alt attribute (alt="" counts — declared decorative).
rules.fix: Meaningful images get words. Decorative ones get alt="" — the attribute is the decision.

rules.check: every carries width and height attributes so the box is reserved before load.
rules.fix: Reserve the space. Nothing below an unsized image should ever move — especially not under a stream.
One attribute decides which voice reads every word on the page. Set it.

rules.summary: a button, link, or summary with no accessible name
rules.check: every button, href link, and summary has text content, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title.
rules.fix: Buttons are verbs. An icon control gets aria-label with the verb — 'Close', not 'X'.
